_note: Page title 'USCIS | Add Client Information'. Slug is indexed (/0) exactly as on the I-485, but this draft ALREADY HAS A CLIENT attached, so the page is in its populated edit state: only the three name fields render (firstName/middleName/lastName, real ids, label[for] wired, placeholders John/Smith), there is NO Add Client button, and next-btn is ENABLED on arrival. The I-485 dump captured the same page in its EMPTY arrival state, where it also carries aNumber + aNumberCheckbox + dateOfBirth + emailAddress and an Add Client gate. Treat the I-485's 7-field shape as the empty-state shape and this 3-field shape as the has-client shape; this walk never saw the empty state, so the aria-labelledby trap documented for the I-485 could not be re-checked here. Next was NOT clicked on this page (it would re-save the existing client); the walk continued by typing the /form URL, which the app allows.
